description.name: Entry
description.text:
Tactical Awoken Mode & +500 ATK to user, Quick ATB 3 to user if Rain/Fina is in party
Tactical Awoken Mode: Ice Ability Boost, Triplecast Ice, Unlimited Ice Hones, Cap Break Level 1 to Ice Abilities, Ice Ability Damage +30% & 20% DEF/RES Pierce to Ice Abilities; Ends after using 8 Ice abilities
TP Max: AOE Ice/NE physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text:
Single-target Ice/NE piercing physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & 30% DEF/RES Pierce to Ice Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold with at least Lv.0/2 En-Ice
WS Blue: Lv.2 En-Ice Stack to user
WS Gold: During Tactical Awoken Mode, chases an Ice ability with Quick ATB 3 (max 1 chase) to user
